# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 109 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 109 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_109_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Chapter 26

**1** "Lord, now that you have explained all these things to me, tell me also: why did the tower not appear to be built on level ground? Why was it built on a rock and on water?" **2** He said to me: "You are wise to ask me about the foundation. **3** This is why the foundation of the tower was laid on the rock and on the water: because your life was saved and shall be saved through water, and the tower was founded on the word of the Almighty and glorious Name; and the Name of the Lord upholds the whole creation. **4** So that the tower, founded on the word of the glorious Name, should stand firm forever, unshaken by any storm of adversity or affliction." **5** I said: "Lord, this is great and marvelous. But tell me further: **6** why were those who repented given first place in the tower, and those who had not repented were placed in the outer parts?" **7** He said: "Because they repented first, having heard the call of repentance, and therefore they were placed nearest to the gate. They were the first to believe after the Son of God was revealed to them." **8** "Tell me, Lord," I said, "what the seal means which was given to those who entered the gate." **9** "Because," he said, "the seal is water. They go down into the water dead, and they come up from it alive. **10** Therefore to these also the seal was proclaimed: that they should enter the kingdom of God." **11** He said to me: "Now go and tell those who are with you the great and glorious things of God that you have seen; and these words shall not be held back from them." **12** He showed me these things clearly; then I fell asleep. He went away from me.

---

*EMET: ch. 109 concludes Similitude 9 with a synthesis of the water/rock/Name theology and the commission to Hermas to proclaim these things. The sleep signals the end of the vision.*
